RESEARCH AGENT
Powered by GPT-6-Astra and Sorol, QORA connects
human scientists, a theoretical agent, Theo, and an ex-
perimental agent, Dex, in a closed feedback loop for quan-
tum control discovery (Fig. 1). Human scientists define
the scientific goals and assign tasks to Theo, while re-
viewing experimental reports from Dex as needed. Theo
coordinates five specialized sub-agents that propose, re-
view, simulate, classify and assemble control sequences.

ture on dynamical decoupling and Hamiltonian engineer-
ing, Theo refines candidate sequences in response to sim-
ulation results. Dex uses the GPT API to interact with
instrument-control software, implementing the selected
sequences, acquiring measurements and calibrating the
apparatus as needed. The resulting data return to Theo
to guide further sequence design.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline T2 gain is established by physical laboratory measurements on the NV ensemble, not by the simulation signal used to select sequences.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Physical optical fluorescence measurements of spin coherence decay on a diamond NV ensemble, including T2 values and robustness sweeps.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Simulated ensemble-averaged differential contrast C(t) across twelve initial states via exact diagonalization, plus iterative experimental calibration and decay profiles.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported coherence improvements and robustness claims align well with the physical measurements and are corroborated by an average Hamiltonian theory analysis explaining why the 18-pulse blocks suppress leading linear/quadratic onsite disorder and drive amplitude errors [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0025, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0026].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation combines physical experiment on a 1.2 ppm diamond NV ensemble with baseline comparisons against the prior state of the art (DROID-C3PO), measuring spin coherence time T2 increases from 9.8 us to 18.6 us, as well as testing robustness against pulse-spacing variations and drive-amplitude Rabi errors [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0015, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0022].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance gains were independently verified via laboratory optical readout of spin coherence decay on an actual diamond NV ensemble and theoretical average Hamiltonian derivation [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0026].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Physical laboratory measurement of spin coherence decay times (T2) via optical fluorescence differential contrast across varied pulse spacings, drive-amplitude errors, and spin-1/2 subspace controls [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0019, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0022, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0027].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Simulated ensemble-averaged differential contrast C(t) across 12 initial states calculated via exact diagonalization, alongside iterative experimental drift calibration and decay profiles [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0012, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0013, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0014].

primary.limitations: The manuscript notes that physical interpretation of the discovered sequence was conducted post-hoc by human researchers rather than by the AI itself, and that validation is currently restricted to spin-1 NV ensembles under specific microwave drive regimes [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0028, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0031].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the split between the theoretical agent (Theo) and experimental control agent (Dex), the exact 18-pulse block structure and composition constraints, exact diagonalization screening across 12 target spin states, and the physical NV Hamiltonian modeling [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0010, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0011, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0012, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0013, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0018].
primary.quality_rationale: The work presents a clear, well-scoped experimental contribution demonstrating the autonomous discovery and physical validation of high-performing quantum control sequences, supported by rigorous experimental baselines, error sweeps, and analytical verification.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript introduces QORA, an LLM-assisted multi-agent framework integrating theoretical proposal/simulation with automated experimental calibration, which discovered the AID-ROD family of dynamical decoupling pulse sequences for dense spin-1 nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center ensembles [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0007, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0010, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021].

Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet re-
mains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially
in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifi-
able objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one
task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to
pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting
downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively
correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work direc-
tions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice
as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an
order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers
published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdo-
mains.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: A pilot human baseline on 23 query pairs produced 95 fixed-choice responses with 61.1% pooled author alignment, consistent with the model range and corroborating that the task elicits meaningful preference variation rather than a purely model-specific artifact.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: The headline outcomes are direct pairwise behavioral choices across balanced A/B orderings, scored against human-authored future-work directions and plausible distractors.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: No training, tuning, selection, or reward signal is used; the study is a zero-shot descriptive evaluation of eight models.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims remain carefully descriptive, explicitly refraining from treating author choice as an objective normative ground truth and framing outcomes as behavioral preferences rather than accuracy [E639f1a641729868a-B0002, E639f1a641729868a-B0036, E639f1a641729868a-B0037]. The observed stability under prompt ablations directly supports the claim that model divergences are not simple surface-level artifacts [E639f1a641729868a-B0021, E639f1a641729868a-B0024].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation evaluates eight frontier and open-weight models, finding author alignment between 45.0% and 67.5% and stable divergence between 15.0% and 36.2% [E639f1a641729868a-B0017]. The authors report inter-model agreement, establish that stable divergence persists across single-variable prompt ablations, and provide a categorical transition analysis showing recurring preferences for scaling and generalization [E639f1a641729868a-B0021, E639f1a641729868a-B0023, E639f1a641729868a-B0031].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: A pilot human baseline across 23 queries collected 108 judgments, finding human author-alignment rates (61.1% pooled, 61.6% macro) within the same range as evaluated models [E639f1a641729868a-B0026, E639f1a641729868a-B0027].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Direct pairwise behavioral selection choices across orderings, evaluated against human-authored ground truth and distractor options [E639f1a641729868a-B0016, E639f1a641729868a-B0017].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Not applicable; the study conducts zero-shot behavioral evaluation without training, fine-tuning, or optimizing models against any internal objective or evaluator [E639f1a641729868a-B0015, E639f1a641729868a-B0036].

primary.limitations: The manuscript candidly acknowledges reliance on a single LLM (Sonnet 4.5) for text extraction and distractor filtering, the small sample size (80 pairs from 19 ML papers), restriction to ML subdomains, single-temperature sampling, and the pilot scale of the human baseline [E639f1a641729868a-B0016, E639f1a641729868a-B0028, E639f1a641729868a-B0037, E639f1a641729868a-B0038, E639f1a641729868a-B0039].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, extracting research contexts and ground-truth future works from post-cutoff papers, pairing them with length-matched, distinct, and plausible distractors from related papers, and evaluating choices across balanced A/B orderings to measure consistency [E639f1a641729868a-B0011, E639f1a641729868a-B0013, E639f1a641729868a-B0014, E639f1a641729868a-B0016]. Controls include prompt ablations, context similarity comparisons, and a pilot human baseline [E639f1a641729868a-B0021, E639f1a641729868a-B0022, E639f1a641729868a-B0026].
primary.quality_rationale: The paper provides a well-designed, transparently controlled behavioral evaluation of an open-ended concept (research taste) with solid methodology, rigorous order controls, insightful ablation experiments, and appropriate contextualization of limitations.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces a descriptive behavioral benchmark of 80 pairwise comparisons to measure research taste in LLMs via future research direction selection, tracking author alignment, stable divergence, and position-sensitive unstable choices across eight frontier and open-weight models [E639f1a641729868a-B0002, E639f1a641729868a-B0007, E639f1a641729868a-B0011].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The paper provides a well-designed, transparently controlled behavioral evaluation of an open-ended concept (research taste) with solid methodology, rigorous order controls, insightful ablation experiments, and appropriate contextualization of limitations.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript candidly acknowledges reliance on a single LLM (Sonnet 4.5) for text extraction and distractor filtering, the small sample size (80 pairs from 19 ML papers), restriction to ML subdomains, single-temperature sampling, and the pilot scale of the human baseline [E639f1a641729868a-B0016, E639f1a641729868a-B0028, E639f1a641729868a-B0037, E639f1a641729868a-B0038, E639f1a641729868a-B0039].
